_comment: Zenith homepage composition. Replaces Dawn's default index.json. Each section below corresponds to a .liquid file in /sections. Future sections (drill library, training-guide promo, shop strip, BYP CTA, etc.) will be added between hero-zenith and footer-zenith as they ship.

settings.subhead: The TEKKY® is a patent-pending technical training ball — smaller than regulation so every touch sharpens, weighted to FIFA Size 5 spec so every rep builds real strength. Use it alongside your standard ball to build precision, confidence, and strength that transfers directly to match day.
settings.trust_2: Founded by Philip + Paul · 40+ yrs coaching

settings.name: Philip Lund
settings.quote: To inspire kids to enjoy the process of improvement, build confidence, and fall in love with the game. This is not just about training — it is about building a culture.

settings.name: Paul Hanson
settings.quote: I've spent extensive years coaching, always with a clear focus on true player development — not just winning games. My approach remains rooted in long-term growth over short-term accolades.

settings.heading: Built by coaches who've seen the gap.
settings.intro: Philip Lund and Paul Hanson have spent 40+ combined years in U.S. youth soccer development — coaching club, ECNL, MLS Next, and college programs. They built TEKKY because they kept seeing the same thing: U.S. players hit a technical ceiling at 17–18 that European players don't.

settings.brand_blurb: Building Better Players, One Touch at a Time. The TEKKY® is an innovative training tool designed to reshape the future of US Soccer by building a stronger technical foundation for the next generation of players.
